instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Place the orders of my trading policy at my broker's paper account", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:place-paper-orders-from-a-trading-policy and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give policy (its version, its orders, and its own limits: risk.max_order_notional, risk.max_daily_notional and risk.day_time_zone; risk.allowed_symbols, when given, is the only symbols it may trade), routes (how your broker takes an order, each route with mode "paper") and prices for market orders.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: trade-order (records:read, records:list, records:write); trade-order-event (records:write); trade-day-spend (records:read, records:write).
